summary.text: John Moran is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 9th Suffolk District since June 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Moran was born in Scranton, Pennsylvania.
He assumed office on June 7, 2023, succeeding Jon Santiago, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and the Joint Committees on Health Care Financing, Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery, Public Service, and Ways and Means.
